description: This Java source file defines the IncludeReference class used in Android Studio's layout rendering system. It manages references to included layout files, handles resource resolution, and provides utility methods for manipulating include references within XML layout files.

classes.name: IncludeReference
classes.description: Represents a reference to an included layout file in Android layout XML, providing methods to access source and target files, resource information, and utility functions for managing include references.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new IncludeReference instance with specified module, source file, and optional target file.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with this include reference.

methods.name: getFromPath
methods.description: Returns the file system path of the source file.

methods.name: getToFile
methods.description: Returns the destination file (the included file).

methods.name: getToPath
methods.description: Returns the file system path of the included file, if known.

methods.name: getFromDisplayName
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly display name for the include reference.

methods.name: getFromResourceName
methods.description: Returns the resource name of the source layout.

methods.name: getFromResourceUrl
methods.description: Returns the resource URL (e.g., @layout/filename) for the source layout.

methods.name: getIncludingLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout that includes the current layout, if specified.

methods.name: setIncludingLayout
methods.description: Sets the layout that includes the current layout.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Determines the include reference for a given XML layout file, resolving the included layout if specified.
